intro: Savannah Lion Tusks are hefty fangs taken from the predatory big cats roaming the arid plains of the Barrens. While common hunting trophies for travelers, they serve an exotic purpose as a brewing ingredient for Chen Stormstout's legendary potent ale.

p: The great cats of the Barrens—from prowlers and huntresses to majestic prides ruled by patriarchs and beasts like Humar the Pridelord—are armed with sharp, heavy tusks. While most who fell these predators take their teeth as simple proof of prowess, Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet seeks them out for a far more spirited craft. Drohn uses the tusks alongside plainstrider kidneys and thunder lizard horns to recreate Chen Stormstout's famous namesake brew, imparting a legendary kick that few mortal gullets can easily withstand.
